content.comment_body: I have a LENOVO computer with Windows 10 and no built-in ethernet connection. I use a LENOVO USB-to-Ethernet adapter to connect to a [product_name] module with [article_no], and this setup works fine with [product_name] version 8. However, when upgrading to [version_no] 8.1 and 8.2, the connection doesn’t work anymore. On a Windows 7 HP computer with the same hardware, everything functions as expected.

Hello, could you please share more details? What is the firmware version of your [product_name] version 8? You can check this on the module’s display. Also, which version of [product_name] [product_name] software did you use previously? Regards, [user_name]
Hello, In the CMD window, please try pinging the [product_name] module. For example: ping 192.168.0.20. What is the result?

analysis.insight_summary: Users observed that Ethernet connectivity between a Lenovo computer running Windows 10 and a [product_name] module with [article_no] works reliably with the initial hardware and software setup but fails when upgraded to [version_no] 8.1 and 8.2. The same connection works on Windows 7, suggesting a likely driver or compatibility issue linked to the updated modules or software, rather than hardware or the operating system in general.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect stable and reliable connectivity between their [product_name] module and PC after upgrading to [version_no] 8.1 or 8.2, regardless of the Windows version or the type of Ethernet adapter being used.
